reader_guide: a11oy.net is the proof registry and canonical RECORD index of pointers. This repository has no receipt store. a-11-oy.com is the command center. https://a-11-oy.com/verify is the interactive tool that checks a record, not the record itself. Live receipts stay on the product Space. Do not merge hosts. Never a11oy.com.
